requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that validate transformation of sponsor name into a display-ready string.
The system must include unit tests that validate normalization of sponsor type into expected label values.
The system must include unit tests that validate mapping of funding source values to public, private, or undisclosed labels.
The system must include unit tests that validate formatting of multiple collaborators into a display-ready list.
The system must include unit tests that validate generation of score contribution display text from numeric input.
The system must include UI tests that verify sponsor name is rendered in the sponsor credibility component.
The system must include UI tests that verify sponsor type is rendered in the sponsor credibility component.
The system must include UI tests that verify funding source is rendered with correct label in the sponsor credibility component.
The system must include UI tests that verify collaborators are rendered when present.
The system must include UI tests that verify score contribution text is rendered in the sponsor credibility component.
The system must include UI tests that verify correct rendering when multiple collaborators are provided.
The system must include UI tests that verify graceful handling and display when funding source is missing.
The system must include unit tests that validate behavior when funding source input is null or undefined.
The system must include UI tests that verify the component does not render empty or broken fields when optional data is missing.
The system must ensure all new unit tests execute successfully in the existing frontend test suite without failures.
The system must ensure all new UI tests execute successfully in the existing frontend test framework without breaking existing tests.
The system must include tests that validate correct integration between transformed sponsor data and the UI component props.
The system must include tests that verify consistent rendering behavior across different valid sponsor data combinations.
